### 👤 **About Me**
[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/-azizzina.tn-black?logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://azizzina.tn)
[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/aziz--zina-0077b5?logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,)](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aziz-zina/)
<img src="https://komarev.com/ghpvc/?username=aziz-zina&style=flat-square&label=Profile%20Views&color=0077B5" alt="Profile Views" />

I am a Software Engineer and an Engineering student based in Tunisia, with 2+ years of experience building scalable web applications. I specialize in Spring Boot, Angular, and clean architecture (Hexagonal / DDD), with a strong focus on integrating AI-driven features into real-world systems.

I enjoy solving complex problems, writing clean and maintainable code, and building performant, cloud-ready applications.

🔭 Current Work: Building scalable full-stack systems and AI features (RAG, chatbots, automation)
💡 Focus Areas: SaaS platforms, multi-tenancy, Keycloak-based authentication, and system design
🌱 Learning: Advanced microservices, distributed systems, cloud deployment (AWS/Azure), and DevOps practices.
🤝 Interests: Open-source contributions and software architecture discussions
